Boundary: Host/Hyper-V, credentials, native interface/profile providers, lifecycle mutations, lease and PowerShell Direct calls are mocked. Snapshot/export hashing, private TestDrive records, synthetic XML generation and independent XML readback are real. Separate source gates parse/import, verify nested observation dependencies and generate public synthetic settings in memory; they make no WLAN/VM call. Installed Prepare WhatIf reads actual configuration without querying the guest or changing its hold.

Implementation.Completion: Saved private local observation only; no VM/WLAN query or hold
Implementation.Snapshot: Six modules plus the public synthetic settings fixture, seven fixed paths
Implementation.Lifecycle: Nine checks and three distinct restored Import/Replace/Remove runs, then verified export
Implementation.Discovery: Bounded interface/profile-list provider; returned observation contains only GUIDs and states, with no profile names, descriptions, XML or keys
Implementation.Selection: Lifecycle accepts only an explicit GUID from the same request/lease Prepare observation; both host and guest enforce this

Recovery: NotRun and failures retain the guest and hold. Failed guest phases attempt partial export. Private export includes synthetic XML and guest/account-bound DPAPI records; it is not portable recovery. Explicit checkpoint reset requires verified export, Off verification and matching hold release. Off retry requires prior reset intent and unchanged export. No WLAN service start, component install, forced profile cleanup or new UAC prompt.
